site.hero_caption: Vol. I — October 2026 · A tea timer · Free and open · MIT

data.title: Overview
data.body:
> Patience is a leaf. It opens when it's ready, not before.

## Say what's in the pot

Green, black, oolong or herbal: pick it once and Kettle times every steep after.

## What it is instead of

- **A kitchen timer** — it doesn't know the leaf
- **Guessing** — fine until the third bitter cup

data.title: How it works
data.summary: Pick the tea, press once, pour when it chimes.
data.body:
1. **Pick the tea.** Green, black, oolong or herbal.
2. **Press once.** Kettle starts the steep.
3. **Pour when it chimes.** Every cup, the same.
